models.author: mistralai
models.runtime_note: Requires a vLLM server exposing /v1/audio/speech; Vocal proxies to VOXTRAL_TTS_URL (default http://localhost:8080)

models.name: OmniVoice
models.description: OmniVoice — zero-shot voice cloning and voice design TTS for 600+ languages. RTF ~0.025 on GPU. Supports non-verbal symbols and pronunciation hints.
models.author: k2-fsa

models.name: Qwen3 TTS 1.7B VoiceDesign
models.description: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B VoiceDesign — create a voice from a natural-language description. Apache-2.0. Requires: pip install "vocal-ai[qwen3-tts]" and an NVIDIA GPU.
models.author: Qwen

models.name: Chatterbox Multilingual V3
models.description: Chatterbox Multilingual V3 — 23 languages, zero-shot cloning, MIT. Loads t3_mtl23ls_v3. Requires: pip install "vocal-ai[chatterbox]" Upstream repo was retired as research in Aug 2026; kept for existing deployments.
models.author: ResembleAI

models.name: Supertonic 3
models.description: Supertonic 3 — on-device ONNX TTS, 31 languages, 10 preset voices (M1–M5, F1–F5). Does not use the GPU. Requires: pip install "vocal-ai[supertonic]" (pinned to supertonic==1.3.1).
models.author: Supertone

models.name: VoxCPM2
models.description: VoxCPM2 — Apache-2.0 TTS, 30 languages, 48 kHz, voice design and reference-audio cloning. About 8 GB VRAM. Requires: pip install "vocal-ai[voxcpm]"
models.author: OpenBMB

models.name: Cohere Transcribe
models.description: Cohere Transcribe (Mar 2026) — 2B Conformer/Transformer ASR, 5.77% avg WER on the Open ASR Leaderboard, 14 languages, long-form friendly. No timestamps, no diarization, no auto language detection. Gated repo: accept the licence on Hugging Face and set HF_TOKEN before pulling.
models.author: CohereLabs

models.name: Granite Speech 5.0 2B
models.description: IBM Granite Speech 5.0 2B (Oct 2026) — 5.96% avg WER, prompt-based language control and keyword biasing. No timestamps, no diarization, no auto language detection; keep segments under ~2 minutes.
models.author: ibm-granite

models.name: Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC
models.description: IBM Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC (Oct 2026) — non-autoregressive CTC decoder, the throughput leader for English and 7 European languages (21,174x real time on H200). Emits <|nospeech|> on silence; no timestamps.
models.author: ibm-granite

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B
models.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming (Jun 2026) — cache-aware FastConformer + RNNT built for voice agents: native streaming at 80-1120 ms chunks, automatic language detection across 40 locales. Needs nemo_toolkit[asr] >= 3.0 (the nemotron-3.5 collection).
models.author: nvidia

models.name: Phonon 31M English
models.description: Phonon 31M (Nov 2026) — Apache-2.0 Rust/GGUF TTS, 64 MB, runs on CPU with no PyTorch, ~100 shipped voices, true streaming. Audio-prompt cloning is not supported (voices are precomputed latents). Requires: pip install "vocal-ai[phonon]".
models.author: gradium

models.name: Ming 3.0 TTS 0.5B
models.description: Ming 3.0 TTS 0.5B — MIT, 44.1 kHz, zero-shot cloning plus a shipped voice catalogue and voice-design tasks. External runtime only: no PyPI package, clone inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts and run its own environment (pins transformers==4.46.3, which conflicts with Vocal's 5.x stack).
models.runtime_note: Requires the vendored inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts runtime (transformers==4.46.3); no PyPI package
models.author: inclusionAI

models.name: Higgs TTS 3 4B
models.description: Higgs TTS 3 4B (Sep 2026) — best-in-class open TTS quality (SeedTTS WER 1.11, 100+ languages, 21 emotions and inline style/SFX control). Non-commercial licence: serving it as a hosted API needs a separate Boson AI agreement. External runtime: vLLM-Omni or SGLang-Omni only.
models.runtime_note: Serve with vllm-omni or sglang-omni; no transformers/vocal adapter path
models.author: bosonai

models.name: Fish Audio Drama 3
models.description: Fish Audio Drama 3 (Oct 2026) — top open-weight quality on the Artificial Analysis voice board (1275 Elo), 83 languages, multi-speaker scenes and word-level audio editing. Community Licence: commercial use only below USD 500k revenue and never as a hosted TTS service. External runtime: SGLang-Omni or vLLM-Omni, 48 GB+ VRAM.
models.runtime_note: SGLang-Omni or vLLM-Omni, >=48 GB VRAM (FP8); no CPU/MPS path
models.author: fishaudio
